articles.title: Red, Blue & Camo: One State, Two Teams, One Guard
articles.summary: The Utah National Guard supported the University of Utah-BYU football rivalry game Nov. 7, 2026, at Rice-Eccles Stadium through a series of military appreciation activities that brought together service members, fans and students from both schools.

articles.title: Georgia Guardsmen battle in combined-MSC competition
articles.summary: Eight Georgia Army National Guard Soldiers competed in the Fiscal Year 2027 Combined Best Warrior Competition Nov. 6–8, 2026, at Fort Stewart, Georgia. The 78th Troop Command named U.S. Army Sgt. 1st Class Jeremy Nicoli its Noncommissioned Officer of the Year and U.S. Army Spc. Clinet Reier its Soldier of the Year.

articles.title: ROK-U.S. Combined Forces Command Marks 48 Years of Combined Defense
articles.summary: CFC commemorates 48 years of strengthening the ROK-U.S. alliance and maintaining readiness on the Korean Peninsula

articles.title: Tennessee Guard Soldier's promotion reunites former public affairs team
articles.summary: Tennessee Army National Guard Master Sgt. Lila A. Walker, a former public affairs specialist with the 118th Mobile Public Affairs Detachment, was promoted during a ceremony at Joint Force Headquarters in Nashville, Tennessee, Nov. 8, 2026.

articles.title: 73 APS welcomes new commander
articles.summary: U.S. Air Force Maj. Charles Smith assumed command of the 73rd Aerial Port Squadron during a ceremony here Nov. 7, 2026.

articles.title: Ohio National Guard launches new partnership during inaugural visit to Angola
articles.summary: LUANDA, Angola — Ohio National Guard leaders traveled to Angola from June 29 to July 3, 2026, for the organization’s first official visit since Ohio and Angola were paired through the State Partnership Program.

articles.title: Behind the Flight Line: 162nd Wing AGE Airmen Power the Mission
articles.summary: Aerospace Ground Equipment Airmen assigned to the 162nd Wing, Arizona Air National Guard, maintain essential ground support equipment at Morris Air National Guard Base, Arizona.

articles.title: Keeping the Mission Moving: Staff Sgt. Ryon Grant
articles.summary: U.S. Air National Guard Staff Sgt. Ryon Grant, a vehicle maintenance technician assigned to the 162nd Logistics Readiness Squadron, Arizona Air National Guard, plays a vital role in maintaining mission readiness at Morris Air National Guard Base, Arizona.

articles.title: Kentucky Air Guard stands up dedicated recruiting flight
articles.summary: The Kentucky Air National Guard has activated a new unit dedicated to recruiting the next generation of Guard Airmen across the Commonwealth.

articles.title: Contingency Response Group stages defender training for multiple units in Puerto Rico
articles.summary: Airmen from the Kentucky Air National Guard’s 123rd Contingency Response Group staged security forces training in Puerto Rico recently to benefit more than 30 Guard defenders from multiple units.

articles.title: High Rollers’ 2026 accomplishments noted during Saturday’s change of command ceremony
articles.summary: Col. Erik Brown became the 26th wing commander of the 152nd Airlift Wing, Nevada Air National Guard, during a ceremony Saturday at the air base in Reno.

articles.title: Georgia Air National Guard adds seven recruits during Ghost Pirates Military Appreciation Game
articles.summary: Seven future Airmen took the oath of enlistment during a Savannah Ghost Pirates' Military Appreciation Weekend Nov. 6 at Enmarket Arena, marking a memorable milestone for the 165th Airlift Wing.

articles.title: U.S. Forces Disable Cargo Vessel Attempting to Violate Naval Blockade
articles.summary: TAMPA, Fla. — U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) forces disabled a commercial vessel in the Gulf of Oman, Nov. 7, after the ship’s civilian crew ignored repeated warnings and attempted to violate the naval blockade against Iran multiple times.

articles.title: Passing on The Tradition: Father, Son Serve Together as Oldest, Youngest Marine at Birthday Ball
articles.summary: MYRTLE BEACH, S.C. – The passing of U.S. Marine Corps tradition and legacy took on a special polish for Marines and Sailors with Combat Logistics Battalion 26, 2nd Marine Logistics Group, during the battalion’s 251st Marine Corps birthday ball, Nov. 6, 2026.

articles.title: CENTCOM Launches Task Force to Disrupt Iranian Ground Transit Routes Supporting Illegal Shipments
articles.summary: TAMPA, Fla. — On Nov. 7, the commander of U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) directed the establishment of a task force that will support ongoing U.S. government efforts to prevent Iran from using ground routes to transport advanced weapons and other materials.

articles.title: The 28th Thai-American Consultation Senior Staff Talks strengthen Alliance
articles.summary: CAMP H.M. SMITH, Hawaii — Senior leaders from the Royal Thai Army and U.S. Pacific Command participated in the 28th Thai-American Consultation Senior Staff Talks at Camp H. M. Smith on Nov. 6, 2026, reinforcing the longstanding military partnership between Thailand and the United States.

articles.title: CNFJ/RJ Celebrates 100 Years of Heritage Site
articles.summary: FLEET ACTIVITIES YOKOSUKA, Japan – Commander U.S. Naval Forces Japan/Navy Region Japan (CNFJ/RJ) commemorated the 100th anniversary of its current Headquarters, historic Building C-1, during a ceremony at Fleet Activities Yokosuka, Nov. 7, 2026.

articles.title: The Idaho Army National Guard and Boise Fire Department Train to Enhance Hoist Capabilities
articles.summary: The Idaho Army National Guard’s State Aviation Group trained with members of the Boise Fire Department’s swift water dive team this week on Gowen Field.

articles.title: US Army feeds culinary soldiers new job title
articles.summary: Formerly known as culinary specialists, a soldier with the 92G occupation identifier will henceforth be known as a “tactical field feeding specialist.”

articles.title: Cambodia and U.S. Pacific Command participate in a Bilateral Defense Dialogue
articles.summary: Senior defense officials from the United States and Cambodia concluded the 2026 Bilateral Defense Discussion (BDD) with the signing of a landmark Terms of Reference (ToR) between the U.S. Pacific Command and Cambodia’s Ministry of National Defense in Phnom Penh, Cambodia, Nov. 4, 2026.

articles.title: Ingenuity on display as students engineer high-flying pumpkin launchers at Armaments Center
articles.summary: PICATINNY ARSENAL, N.J. - It was pumpkin seeds aplenty as the annual Pumpkin Sling returned to the U.S. Army Combat Capabilities Development Command (DEVCOM) Armaments Center on Friday, Oct. 30.

articles.title: Six ‘Warrior Medics’ excel in, graduate from H2F-I course
articles.summary: Fourteen U.S. Army Reserve Soldiers throughout the Army Reserve medical enterprise, six of whom are assigned to the Army Reserve Medical Command headquarters here, took part in and graduated from the Holistic Health and Fitness- Integrator, or H2F-I, course held at the C.W. Bill Young Armed Forces Reserve Center here, Oct. 18-30, 2026.
